text: Unified National Testing (UNT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Kyrgyzstan Аттестат о среднем общем образовании (Certificate of Completed Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. National Scholarship Test (NST) may be requested in non-standard applications. Malaysia UEC: a minimum of five subjects with at least grade B6, and at least grade B4 in Math/Physics for our Engineering/Science programmes will be considered for Year 1 entry. The following certificates are accepted for Year 2 direct entry: UEC: a minimum of five subjects with A2 in one subject and B3 in four subjects, excluding Bahasa Malay and Book Keeping and Commerce, plus High school Graduation certificate. STPM: Grade B in three of the five subjects. English proficiency: UEC English B4 (Y1 entry only) or SPM 1119 (UCLES board) English C Myanmar Three-year high school graduation with an average score and relevant subjects in 60%, plus Basic Education High School Examination/Matriculation Examination with a minimum score of 400 and no subjects lower than 60%. Mongolia Certificate of Complete Secondary Education with an average of B (or 80%), plus University Entrance Examination (UEE) with at least three Bs in relevant subjects. Nepal School Leaving Certificate (Grade XI &XII) from the National Examinations Board (NEB), with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 Pakistan Higher Secondary School Certificate (also known as Intermediate Certificate) with an average of 70%, and 70% in relevant subjects. Philippines Senior High School Diploma (Academic Track) with an average of 80%, and 80% in relevant subjects. Saudi Arabia General Secondary Education Certificate with an overall mark 75% or above. Singapore Singapore Cambridge A-levels with BBB is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Singapore Cambridge O Level English C South Korea High School Certificate of Graduation with rank 5 or score 70%, and rank 5 or score 70% in relevant subjects. College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) may be requested in non-standard applications. Thailand M6 School Leaving Certificate with an average of Grade 3 and with specific subject requirements. Uzbekistan Umumiy o’rta ta’lim to’g’risida attestat / shahodatnoma (Certificate of General Secondary Education) with an average of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Vietnam Bang Tot Nghiep Pho Thong Trung Hoc (Senior Secondary School Graduation Diploma) with an overall average of 7 (out of 10) with specific requirement in relevant subjects, plus National Senior Secondary School Graduation Examinations with specific requirements. Australasia Australia Successful completion of year 12 with High School qualification and a satisfactory admission index/entrance rank ATAR (Australian Tertiary Admission Rank) with 86% is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Australian High School qualification examples: Australian Capital Territory Senior Secondary Certificate, New South Wales Higher School Certificate New Zealand National Certificate of Educational Achievement (NCEA) Level 3 is accepted for Year Two entry. Applicants should achieve: – 46 or more credits ranging from Merit to Excellent (excluding Learning Recognition credits), and – including three subjects at Level 3 or above, made up of 12 credits each at Excellent, and – Literacy – 10 credits at Level 2 or above, made up of 5 credits in reading and 5 credits in writing. Numeracy – 10 credits at Level 1 or above. Applicants should provide detailed description of their academic qualification. Europe France French Baccalaureat with 12 overall out of 20 with 12 in specified subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: French Baccalaureat English 13 Germany Zeugnis der Allgemeine Hochschulreife / Abitur with a minimum of 2.5 overall with a minimum of 10 in two Leistungskurse (advanced) subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. English proficiency: Abitur English 12 Italy Diploma di Esame di Stato with a minimum of 80% overall is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Netherlands Voorbereidend Wetenschappelijk Onderwijs (VWO) with a minimum of 7 overall out of 10 is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. Russia Attestat o Srednem Obshchem Obrazovanii (Certificate of Secondary Education) with an average grade of 4 (out of 5), and 4 in relevant subjects. Certificate of Unified State Examination may be requested in non-standard applications. United Kingdom (UK) AS-Levels will be considered for Year 1 entry. GCE A-Levels with BBB or IB with 30 points is accepted for Year 2 direct entry. North America Canada High School Diploma will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. Such as: British Columbia: British Columbia Senior Secondary School Diploma with grades BBBBB in grade 12 subjects; Ontario: Secondary School Diploma OSSD with an average of 70%, including six Grade 12 U, U/C, M courses (study in-person on campus for 2-3 years). OSSD awarded outside of Canada must be from an Awarding school listed on the Canadian Government website as a school authorised to award Ontario Secondary School Diploma credits. Other provinces: Secondary/High/Senior School Diploma with 70% average and 70%, 70%, 70%, 70%, 70% in grade 12 subjects. United States of America (USA) High School Graduation Diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above will be considered for Year 1 entry. Students who take AP Exams or ACT Tests will be considered for Year 2 direct entry. High school diploma with a GPA of 3.0/4.0 or above, plus: 3 AP exams: 4, 4, 4 or SAT I: 1280 or ACT: 27, and 2 AP exams: 4, 4 South America Brazil Certificado de Ensino Medio with grades of six, and six in relevant subjects. The Caribbean CAPE Diploma including three two-Unit level subjects (excluding core subjects) at grade II with specific requirement in relevant subjects is accepted for Year 2 direct entry.
